clause_text: Client shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless Company and its officers, directors, and employees from any and all claims, damages, losses and liabilities, including attorneys fees, arising out of or related to Client's use of the Services, without any limitation.
Each party's total liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid in the three (3) months prior to the claim.

All work product and deliverables created by Company shall be deemed works made for hire and shall be the sole and exclusive property of Client, including all intellectual property rights therein, in perpetuity.
Either party may terminate this Agreement for any reason upon thirty (30) days written notice to the other party.
Company may terminate this Agreement immediately upon written notice if Client becomes insolvent, makes an assignment for the benefit of creditors, or if a receiver is appointed.

Each party agrees to keep confidential all Confidential Information of the other party and not to disclose such information to any third party without prior written consent. This obligation shall survive termination of this Agreement for a period of five (5) years.
Client shall pay all invoices within fifteen (15) days. Late payments shall accrue interest at five percent (5%) per month compounded monthly, plus all collection costs and attorneys fees.

Any dispute arising under this Agreement shall be resolved by binding arbitration. The prevailing party shall be entitled to recover its reasonable attorneys fees and costs from the non-prevailing party.
IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY BE LIABLE FOR ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, EXEMPLARY, OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES, INCLUDING LOST PROFITS, LOSS OF DATA, OR BUSINESS INTERRUPTION.

Company hereby grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify, and distribute the software. Client may sublicense this right to third parties without restriction.
Company's maximum liability for any claims arising out of this Agreement shall be limited to $5,000, while Client's liability is unlimited.
Company shall indemnify Client against all claims, and Company's total liability for any breach is capped at $10, while Client's liability is uncapped, and Client shall not be subject to any cap.
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware.
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Cayman Islands.
Neither party shall be liable for any delay or failure to perform due to causes beyond its reasonable control, including acts of God, war, or natural disasters.
Each party represents and warrants that it has the full power and authority to enter into this Agreement.
Company warrants that the services will be error-free, uninterrupted, and meet all of Client's requirements, and Company will indemnify Client for any failure to meet this warranty.
Company may not assign its rights or delegate its duties under this Agreement without the prior written consent of Client, which consent may be withheld in Client's sole discretion.
Either party may assign this Agreement to an affiliate or in connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all of its assets.
Company shall keep all Client information strictly confidential for a period of twenty (20) years, whereas Client has no obligation of confidentiality regarding Company's information.

Company shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Client from any and all third-party claims, liabilities, losses, damages, or costs, including reasonable attorneys fees, arising out of any breach of this Agreement by Company, without limitation.
Client shall pay all invoices within ninety (90) days of receipt. No late fees or interest shall accrue on any overdue amounts.
Client may terminate this Agreement at any time for convenience upon five (5) days written notice. Company shall not be entitled to any refund or payment for work in progress upon such termination.
Any dispute arising under this Agreement shall be resolved exclusively in the courts of London, England, and both parties submit to the personal jurisdiction of such courts.
All intellectual property, proprietary information, and materials developed or created by Company prior to or during the term of this Agreement shall be the sole and exclusive property of Client.
Provider shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Client from any and all claims whatsoever, without any limitation, cap, or exclusion.
Client's liability for any claim arising under this Agreement is uncapped, while Provider's total liability shall not exceed the fees paid in the preceding six (6) months.
Provider shall provide the Services with reasonable care and skill; Client shall have the right of first refusal to renew this Agreement on the same commercial terms for successive one-year terms.

Each party's aggregate liability arising out of or related to this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees paid or payable under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.

Each party shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the other party from third-party claims arising out of the indemnifying party's gross negligence or willful misconduct, subject to the liability cap in Section 5.
Either party may terminate this Agreement upon sixty (60) days prior written notice for convenience, without penalty to either party.
